title: MobileSecurityPolicy - Data API
description: Enables mobile security policies on the Salesforce mobile app with Enhanced Mobile Security. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name of the object in the API. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

EffectiveDate.description: The date a mobile security policy is enforced.

IsEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsEnabled.description: A value indicating whether a mobile security policy is enabled. The default value is 'false'.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: The two-to five-character code that represents the language and locale ISO.

MasterLabel.description: The label of the mobile security policy.

MobilePlatform.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
MobilePlatform.description: The mobile operating system. Possible values are: Android iOS

MobileSecurityAssignmentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MobileSecurityAssignmentId.description: Indicates the ID of the mobile security assignment. This is a relationship field.

NamespacePrefix.description: The namespace prefix that is associated with this object. Each Developer Edition org that creates a managed package has a unique namespace prefix. Limit: 15 characters. You can refer to a component in a managed package by using the namespacePrefix__componentName notation. The namespace prefix can have one of the following values. In Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is set to the namespace prefix of the org for all objects that support it, unless an object is in an installed managed package. In that case, the object has the namespace prefix of the installed managed package. This field’s value is the namespace prefix of the Developer Edition org of the package developer. In orgs that aren’t Developer Edition orgs, NamespacePrefix is set only for objects that are part of an installed managed package. All other objects have no namespace prefix.

RuleValue.description: Value of the mobile security policy rule.

RuleValueType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RuleValueType.description: The type of mobile security policy rule. Possible values are: Boolean Text TextList

SeverityLevel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SeverityLevel.description: The severity level of a mobile security policy. Possible values are: Critical Error Info Warn

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: The type of mobile security policy.
